facts.claim: MSC Opera (MSC Cruises): Entered service 2004; 65,591 GT; 2150 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Lirica class.
MSC Opera is a cruise ship built in 2004, carrying 2,679 passengers in 1,071 cabins, and with a crew complement of approximately 728, currently operated by Swiss company MSC Cruises.

catalogSpecs.description: Lirica-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2004; 65,591 GT; approx. 2,150 guests at double occupancy.
